Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot: Bacterial spot thrives in warm, wet conditions and can cause dark lesions on leaves and fruit, reducing yield.
Pepper__bell___healthy: A healthy pepper plant shows glossy green leaves and firm fruit — indicators of good soil nutrition and watering.
Potato___Early_blight: Early blight in potatoes is caused by Alternaria solani and produces concentric dark rings on leaves, reducing photosynthesis.
Potato___Late_blight: Late blight, the same disease that contributed to the Irish Potato Famine, is caused by Phytophthora infestans.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold: Leaf mold in tomatoes develops in humid conditions and appears as velvety olive-green patches under leaves.
Tomato___healthy: Healthy tomato plants have vibrant green foliage and are less susceptible to pests thanks to good airflow and pruning.
